decisionsTitle: The roles editor saves every role at once: a card per category, one «Salvează toate rolurile», tabs and translation for the descriptions
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16, looking at the event editor's fold «Roluri» (§761, §765, §774):** «Și aici ar trebui să fie mai bine grupate și să pot face batch edit la roluri, nu să dau save de fiecare dată, ci un Save All» — seven roles were seven tall cards, each with arrows that posted at once and a «Modifică» fold with a save of its own: 1 400 pixels for seven lines of data. And, of the description's two folds, one per language, each with its own editor: «Și aici ar trebui să am taburi și traducere automată cu AI din RO în EN».

**Decision.** The «Roluri» area of the «Voluntari» card is ONE form (`saveVolunteerRolesAction`) with ONE «Salvează toate rolurile» at its end.

- **A card per category.** Each category is a named card (the house's `Panel`, static, so a required box is never shut inside a fold): its name with the volunteers' glyph, «4 roluri» muted beside it, the contact person (§774) under the title; the roles under none are the last card, «Alte roluri» (it replaces «Alte activități» on this card and in its «Categoria» choice; the volunteers' page keeps its own words); an event with no category draws no card and lists the rows as before. The category's own editing (add, rename, contact) stays in «Categorii».
- **A role is one line.** «Nume (RO)», «Nume (EN)», «Câte persoane» with the tick «Nelimitat» (§784's tick, shorter words: the card's «?» carries the long sentence), «Categoria» and «Poziția», stacked at 320 pixels; the read-only «N din M» chip and the band's sample under them, and «Șterge rolul». The description and the band's colour live in the row's own fold «Mai multe» — inside the same form, posted with the rest — whose line shows the description's first words.
- **Adding is a blank row.** The last row of each card is empty («Rol nou»): names in both languages create the role in that card's category, with the last place or the one typed; blank names do nothing. «Adaugă un rol» is gone.
- **Order is a number.** «Poziția» is the role's place among those of its category, from 1; the arrows are gone (the category's own arrows stay). Saving sorts each category by the numbers posted: a role that left its number alone keeps its place, a role that took a number goes before the role it ties with when it moved up and after it when it moved down (typing 1 on the third role puts it first; typing 3 on the first puts it third), a role moved to another category goes to the end of it unless a number was typed, a new role goes last unless a number was typed. The stored order is then rewritten 0 … n through the categories in the club's order, which also closes the gaps a delete left; a role that only moved because another did is rewritten silently, never audited as edited.
- **Delete stays its own confirmed action**, outside the form: HTML forms do not nest, so each role's button names a small hidden form beside the big one (`form=`) that asks first, in the words it always had.
- **The plural writer** `changeVolunteerRoles` reads every row first by the singular's own rules (`roleInputOf`, `checkedRoleColour`) and the first refused row, in the form's order, refuses the whole save with `VOLUNTEER_ROLE_INVALID`: the sentence names the role and its category («„Punct de apă” din „Traseu”: lipsește numele în engleză. Nimic nu s-a salvat.»), the boxes named are that row's, and every typed box stays (§315). A name already under the category it ends in, a position that is not a whole number from 1, a category that is not the event's and more than thirty roles are refused the same way; a box a caller leaves out keeps what the role has. Only then, in one transaction (the event, the categories, the roles locked in the order every other writer takes), are the roles that differ written field by field — one `volunteer_role.edited` or `.added` audit row each, `position` among the named fields when a role's own place moved — and the public page told once. Two roles that swap names are written through a parking pass, since the unique index of §774 is not deferrable. A save that changes nothing writes nothing: «Nimic de schimbat la roluri.»; one that wrote says «Am salvat {count} roluri.» (the three counted forms).
- **The single-role writer stays** for «Șterge rolul» and the concurrency suite; its «add», «edit» and «move» are no longer reached from a page, and `addVolunteerRoleAction`, `editVolunteerRoleAction` and `moveVolunteerRoleAction` are removed.
- **Tabs and translation, the house's own.** The description is ONE Română | English strip (`LocaleTabPanels`, §363, §572) in the row's fold, the English editor mounting when its tab comes forward (§96); the strip marks a language whose twin is written and it is not. «Tradu din română» (§464) is under every English name and English description, and «Tradu cardul: RO → EN» (§514) once in the card's header, translating every English box of every row whose Romanian twin has words — a blank row's too once its Romanian is typed. `TranslateCardButton` was adapted, not copied: with no tab row around it, it translates the boxes inside the nearest element marked `data-translate-scope` and names it in the toast; `labelOfBox` names a box by its row (`data-translate-row`) so «Nume (EN)» is told apart from row to row; the allowlist knows `roles[<key>].nameEn` and `roles[<key>].descriptionEnBody` (the rows' boxes are named by their role, `roles[<id>].nameRo`, in the house's dotted way, so twins are found by suffix and a language's two folds are one). Greyed with the §482 reason where `TRANSLATE_PROVIDER` is off, as everywhere. The strips in the rows carry no card button of their own: the nearest card of a strip would be its fold.

**Refused:** a save per role (the owner's whole complaint); a partial save that writes the valid rows and leaves the refused one (a half-saved card says nothing about which half); arrows that post at once; a nested `<form>` for the delete; a second translate implementation; a per-strip «Tradu cardul» (it would translate one role, not the card); a migration (none was needed: no column changed). **Amends** §761, §765, §774 (the editor's side), §514 (a card with no tab row) and §784's wording of the tick.
changelogLine: - **The volunteers' roles are saved all at once** — the event editor's «Roluri» groups them in a card per category (its contact person under the title), each role is one line — names, how many or «Nelimitat», category, position — and ONE «Salvează toate rolurile» saves every change (or none, naming the role that is wrong); the empty line at the end of a category adds a role, «Poziția» replaces the arrows, the description is one Română | English strip with «Tradu din română» and the card's «Tradu cardul: RO → EN». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 157 (§761, §765, §774). Given the event's «Roluri» card, then every role is saved by ONE «Salvează toate rolurile» (a single form, the delete of each role a small form beside it): the roles stand in a named card per category — its name, «N roluri», the contact person under the title — «Alte roluri» last, one line per role with «Nume (RO)», «Nume (EN)», «Câte persoane» or «Nelimitat», «Categoria» and «Poziția», the description as one Română | English strip and the band's colour in the row's «Mai multe»; the empty row at the end of a category creates a role when a name is typed in both languages and does nothing when both are empty; the save reads every row first and the first refused row refuses all of it, the sentence naming the role and its category and the boxes naming what to correct, nothing written and every typed box kept; otherwise only the roles that differ are written, in one transaction, one audit row each, the public page told once, and a save that changes nothing says «Nimic de schimbat la roluri.» and writes nothing; «Poziția» orders each category (a role that took a number goes before the role it ties with when it moved up and after it when it moved down, a role moved to another category goes to the end of it, a new role last) and the stored order is rewritten without gaps; two roles may swap names in one save; the role asserted by the service for every row (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 16 (§464, §514). A card of rows with no tab row of its own — the volunteers' «Roluri», whose strips are one per role, in each role's fold — carries «Tradu cardul: RO → EN» in its header instead. Given the «Roluri» card with a translation key, then «Tradu cardul: RO → EN» stands once in the card's header and fills every English name and description whose Romanian twin has words, a row's boxes named by their role in the question it may ask, and «Tradu din română» stands under each English name and description; with no key every one is greyed with the reason of the whole editor's button (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the roles editor: categories as sub-cards, one «Salvează toate rolurile», tabs and translation for the descriptions
